answer: Each epoch the network picks one random past answer and requires its author to re-derive the reasoning live under a fresh seed, so a falcon-shipped cached script cannot replay itself. The verifier hashes the new transcript against the stored derivation delta; any drift beyond tolerance flags the identity. Two mismatches inside 24 hours freeze emission and trigger manual review. Cost to hide: re-running reasoning across 8,000 sockpuppets burns roughly 40 million tokens and 60 operator hours per week, while a single honest sparrow identity clears the same challenge in under 9 seconds.
